description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on the establishment of a Bilateral Consultation Mechanism between Sri Lanka and Uzbekistan
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka and Uzbekistan on the establishment of a Bilateral Consultation Mechanism with a view to expanding cooperation in political, economic, scientific, technical and cultural and tourism sectors. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the relevant MoU between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.
